title: Qualify allocation failure and pending lifetime
requires: Host mock driver; one advertised native driver
scope: Add public-API failure injection for allocation/upload/submit failure and reset with pending work.
acceptance: Every failure stage has a recovery case and an unchanged unrelated resource.
Evidence distinguishes recording errors from deferred completion errors.
evidence: PASS: public API failure lifecycle test injects allocation, recording, pre-acceptance submission and deferred upload failures; every stage recovers and preserves an unrelated mapped buffer
PASS: advertised Slang CPU async test holds a recorded simulation reset behind a timeline wait, rejects command/fence reset while pending, then completes and reuses both after the producer signal
PASS: build-foundations ctest 44/44, with three expected unsupported production CPU domain skips
PASS: PARALLEL_MATER_SLANG_CPU_LIQUIDS=OFF private fixture build and failure lifecycle test in /tmp/parallel-mater-f106-cpu-off
Docs: RESOURCE-LIFETIME and generated specification distinguish recording, acceptance and deferred completion errors
